What is SMS Gateway Provider?
An SMS or Email Gateway is a system that allows users to send or receive SMS or Email messages. A SMS or Email Gateway Provider is a company that provides such a service at a cost.
In order to use your own SMS and Email Gateway with the plugin you will need to upgrade our premium plans

How do I use my own Email Gateway with the plugin?

If you have your own Email or SMTP Gateway and have configured it on your WordPress site then no further configurations are required on your end. The premium plugin will use those settings to send out OTP Emails to users automatically.

What is a Sender ID?
Sender ID

is a unique alpha-numeric name which appears on the mobile phone as the sender of an SMS. Primarily used for branding purposes and to easily identify the person sending the Message. A Sender ID needs to be registered with the Gateway Provider before it can be used.
Can I change the Sender ID of the message going out from miniOrange?
Customization of the Sender ID with miniOrange is possible if customers have opted for the

. Those looking to change the Sender ID going out in the SMS text need to register and authenticate their ID with the SMS gateway provider before they can use it. Customization of Sender ID is not supported with the
miniOrange Gateway Plan
